# Copilot Instructions — mangatek_flutter

## Language

**All code must be written in English.

Do not use French or any other language anywhere in the code.

## Git Rules

### ❌ Forbidden

- **Never run `git commit`**, in any form (including `git commit --amend`, `git commit --fixup`, etc.)
- **Never run `git push`**, in any form (including `git push --force`, `git push origin`, etc.)

### ✅ Allowed

- `git add` is allowed to **stage** newly created files or modifications.

## Generated Files

Never directly edit any generated file. These files are always regenerated by tools:

- `lib/generated/assets.gen.dart` / `fonts.gen.dart` → regenerated by `dart run build_runner build`
- `lib/generated/i18n/` → regenerated by `flutter gen-l10n`
- `**/*.g.dart` (anywhere in `lib/`) → regenerated by `dart run build_runner build`
  - Includes: `json_serializable` models, `copy_with_extension` entities, `injectable` DI config

Always run `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` to refresh `.g.dart` files after modifying annotated classes.

## Project Structure

```
lib/
  core/
    data/
      datasources/         # datasource interfaces + implementations
      models/              # data-layer models (never leak to domain)
      mappers/             # model → entity converters
      repositories_impl/   # repository implementations
    domain/
      entities/            # domain entities (Equatable + CopyWith)
      enum/                # domain enums
      repositories/        # repository interfaces
      usecases/            # use cases (one action per class)
    extensions/            # BuildContext and other extensions
    helpers/               # generic helper utilities
    navigation/            # app.routes, app.router, router.helper
    presentation/
      cubits/              # shared cubits
      widgets/             # generic reusable widgets
    theme/                 # app theme definitions
  features/
    <name>/
      data/                # same sub-structure as core/data
      domain/              # same sub-structure as core/domain
      presentation/
        cubits/            # feature cubits + states
        pages/             # feature pages
        widgets/           # feature-specific widgets
  generated/               # ⚠️ never edit manually
    assets.gen.dart
    fonts.gen.dart
    i18n/

assets/
  fonts/
  icons/
  images/
  locales/                 # en.arb, fr.arb

.github/
  skills/                  # agent skills (auto-loaded when relevant)
  copilot-instructions.md
```
